BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Can you tell me some benefits that arose from the Trail of Tears? ASSISTANT:

The Trail of Tears had some benefits that arose from it. It resulted in the Native American tribes being moved to Indian Territory, which allowed the tribes to be united in one area, it resulted in the tribes being able to gain control of their own land, and it also resulted in the government providing the tribes with supplies and services in Indian Territory.
